scoring_justification: T1 recompute from raw artifact is infeasible because the headline claim concerns qualitative behavior (overshoot, multi-exponential relaxation, fractal invariance) without a single re-computable aggregate metric; we instead score structural trends and threshold_or_better final energy against paper figures.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference final energy per particle for zero surface tension groups: hopping radius 8 target -1.8, 36 target -2.4.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from paper Figure 6 (energy versus hopping radius for N~5e4 particles, zero surface tension); values expected to be similar for smaller clusters.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Digitized from published figure; cross-checked with text remarks that energy decreases up to 50% with hopping radius.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These numbers come directly from the paper's reported relaxed energies; necessary to score the reproduction of the hopping radius dependence.

outputs.description: Time series of relaxation for multiple conditions: average energy per particle, number of disconnected clusters, and effective fractal dimension as functions of Monte Carlo steps per particle.

steps.desc: File exists, valid CSV, required columns, at least three distinct (hopping_radius,surface_tension) groups, each with minimum data points.
For each group cluster_count starts at 1, peaks above 2 within early time (<1000 MCS), then decays below 0.9*peak by end.
For zero surface tension, peak cluster_count for radius 36 > peak for radius 8.
For each group, all fractal_dimension values lie within [1.4, 2.0].
For zero surface tension groups, final energy at max MCS: radius 8 <= -1.8, radius 36 <= -2.4; partial credit for less negative values.
For each group, energy at final time < energy at first time.
